apps.title: Golf Shot Tracker
apps.desc: Track shot distances with GPS on the course. Tee off, mark, hole out — rounds stay on your device, no account needed.

changelog.notes: This Hole list shows live activity (teeing off, walking to ball, putting). Entering the green auto-marks the approach, then the next shot is putting.
GPS accuracy and tee-box bounds are checked before settle/arm. Auto-tee settle starts only in the tee box; fairway settle stays quiet on bad GPS or while still on the tee.
Settle/arm stays quiet until you walk Min shot move away from the last mark or tee.
Walk to next tee is tappable to set tee GPS and line up the map on a first round.
Jump to Hole sticks instead of snapping back to the nearest mapped tee.
Long-press Set tee maps GPS without starting the hole; auto-mark can fire after first tee-off.
Fix PWA install when opened from Aaron's Apps hub.
Honor ?install=1 from the apps hub to open the install prompt.

apps.title: Road Speed

changelog.notes: Big Set limit buttons for 50 / 60 / 70 / 80 / 100, plus an All speeds screen for 10–110 km/h.
Fix speed stuck at 0: live GPS when listening, derive km/h from movement when the chip reports 0.
Simplify drive UI: auto listen above 10 km/h, auto start/end journeys; Set limit and avg zone stay manual.
Sticky Set limit along the route; mapped stretches from earlier trips; mid-trip overrides only until that stretch ends.
Remove the question-mark install button from the top bar.
Fix PWA install when opened inside the Apps hub.

apps.title: Back Me Up
apps.desc: Arm a backup audio track, listen via mic, and take over instantly if the main amplifier cuts out. Audio stays on device.

changelog.notes: Fine-tune ≥95% via 20% peak crossings (clip vs track); 20s window; viz markers
Revert fine-tune-at-95% + onset viz; keep lock clip-length alignment
Fix hit/lock amp clock: match start + clip length + age; Heard lined under Track
Fine-tune 20s onset window while locked ≥95%; Track viz markers + FINE log
Hold lock on one on-clock weak spot; allow pre-lock catch-up clock drift
Amp-time confidence election; outlier-boot burst slips; tighter gap gate; sub-second pulls only
Amp-ahead hunt bias; locked burst-onset slip over ~20s during spot mode
First-minute silence-gap fingerprint; match heard gaps with tunable error gate; snap sync on GAP MATCH
Silent track only after lock drop/fail — not at session outset
Burst clips: ~200ms preroll onset buffer; end only after ~400ms silence (fewer fragmented clips)
Trail is settings-only; stop auto-measuring/overwriting to 1s on lock
Drop lock below 90% confidence; silent-track only when unlocked; stop re-snapping same gap (log #2)
Reject far teleport hits; gap-seed only near clock; proximity-biased tile ranking (log #1 fix)
Silent-track mode: low conf + 10s+ gap → wait for next burst marker; live Heard roll between spots
Skip track silence on trigger/search; widen micro-hunt when confidence mid/low; slip toward better score
Post-lock Heard clips + micro-align under 95%; freeze track dB peak; shared Heard/Track levels; spot checks at ≥95%
Delay clock until amp audio; cutout slip on auto-resume; silence-gap search seed; Reset zeros Amp/Backup; softer edge cutouts
Heard wave always visible (local bars); coverage soft when score/idf pass; near-miss keeps streak

Softer lock (gaps soft, near-miss streak), forward-wide search, Play track / Reset in Settings, playback seek/mute/volume, auto-resume on cutout when audio returns, Heard viz cleanup, settings expand while locked
Tiled fingerprint matching (10 s tiles) for uneven hash density
Burst-bounded clips, cutout cooldown after lock, cutout event logging
Pill-bar mic meter, settings lock disables controls, sticky strong-lock, release notes blurb
Unified Back me up button (user-clocked track + trail), wide search after repeated misses
